notes: Original experimental article (zeolite-templated, N-doped carbons by CVD); not a review, thesis, patent or abstract. record.json is_retracted is false; a search of main and SI text for 'retract', 'erratum' and 'corrigendum' found nothing. No statement that the H2 uptake values were published before (the introduction says no earlier study of H2 storage on zeolite-templated carbons was known to the authors). Carbon is the majority component: N content 5-8 wt% (Table 1, abstract), residual mass <3% after TGA. H2 uptake measured gravimetrically (IGA-003, 0-20 bar, -196 °C; buoyancy correction stated, Figure 8 caption) and volumetrically (ASAP 2020, 0-1.1 bar, -196 °C; Figure 10). Surface areas were measured on the same carbon samples whose H2 uptake is reported. The SI (si1) holds only Figures 1S and 2S and adds no further criterion evidence.
